characters.prompt: Production illustration sprite atlas for a modern contemplative life simulation website. Transparent background. Precisely 4 columns and 3 rows equal cells, twelve full body characters centered in individual cells with generous transparent padding, feet aligned at bottom of each cell. Top row: four toddlers, second row: four young adults, bottom row: four elderly adults. Each column consistent complexion and appearance across ages: first light skin male dark hair, second medium skin female dark hair, third dark skin male dark hair, fourth warm medium skin female dark hair. Friendly restrained editorial gouache painting, softly shaded realistic proportions stylized storybook illustration, contemporary casual clothes in muted navy blue, cream, sage. Clean silhouettes, standing three-quarter view facing slightly left, no props, no letters or borders, no scenery, no shadows outside figures. Art suitable for compositing in a scenic game stage. Avoid pixel art, emoji, cartoon outlines, photorealism, labels and UI.

stages.prompt: A production background atlas for a contemporary illustrated life simulation. Exactly 2 columns and 3 rows of equal rectangular landscape panels in a 3:2 overall canvas, each individual panel 16:9 or near widescreen. Straight aligned panels no gaps no text. Row one left: a tranquil sunlit modern family living room with a large window and soft blue sofa, right: a bright school classroom with desks and leafy garden outside. Row two left: a calm modern workplace with laptop and bookshelf, right: a walking path beside a lake in a green public park. Row three left: a peaceful retirement home reading nook with armchair and garden, right: a reflective sunset garden with an empty wooden bench. All six scenes have clear empty foreground center-right to composite a standing character. Beautiful restrained editorial gouache painting with soft atmospheric light, sophisticated muted blue cream sage and amber palette, tactile painterly texture, coherent perspective, contemporary elegant travel journal aesthetic. No people no writing no labels no UI no borders no pixel art, no flags or religious objects.
